title: Hourly Auto-Dig:Boao Forum headquarters semantics and current-news scan
summary: Dataset-first Boao Forum pass separates the charter-designated permanent Boao headquarters from a current public Beijing office, queues authoritative current-address resolution, and records that no material post-refresh news was found.

sources.title: Charter of Boao Forum for Asia

data.research_question: What defensible current public geography can be attached to Boao Forum for Asia, and is there material current news since its July 31, 2026 dataset refresh?
data.method: Refreshed current main and operating documentation through the GitHub connector; used the latest complete 54-topic pool on current main; excluded Graphika, fed, and drunk-drivers under the previous-three successful-hourly rule; deterministically selected boao-forum-public-roster with the recorded seed; searched the selected source dataset and its canonical organization; reviewed published charter evidence and the current organization-managed LinkedIn profile; preserved conflicting headquarters semantics instead of flattening them; then searched current news with overlap from 2026-07-20 through 2026-08-19 and found no material post-refresh update.
classification_rules: Dataset stage is approximately uniform across the complete candidate pool after recency exclusions.
Recent dominant geographies New York, Washington, D.C., and Utah were excluded when alternatives existed.
Charter-designated permanent headquarters, registered address, operational office, event venue, and platform headquarters labels remain distinct predicates.
No coordinates are created without a defensible geocoder result.
No filler news records are created when the post-cutoff search finds no material update.

findings.selection_algorithm: sorted complete 54-topic pool -> remove previous-three successful-hourly datasets -> random.Random(seed).choice; then select within the chosen dataset/topic

findings.note: 36 normalized db/investigation-target records were enumerated from current main. The exact full executable Free-Range frontier also includes packet-derived/newly discovered candidates and could not be safely counted without a complete runnable corpus; no synthetic total is asserted.

findings.selection_reason: The selected source dataset contains one canonical organization and no Boao-specific queued investigation-target.

findings.registered_address: 1 Gold Coast Boulevard, Boao, Qionghai City, Hainan Province, China
findings.beijing_public_office: No. 1 Jian Guo Men Wai Avenue, Suite 2210, Chaoyang District, Beijing 100004, China
findings.semantic_conflict: Current LinkedIn platform metadata labels Beijing headquarters while its organization narrative says Boao is the permanent headquarters; modeled as permanent charter HQ plus public Beijing office.

findings.scope: Exact-name web/news search plus current indexed BFA surfaces. Results were dominated by March 2026 annual-conference coverage and older background pages; no material new organizational/location event after the July 31 dataset refresh was found.
